title: Origanum vulgare tincture for medicinal use
intro: Origanum vulgare tincture is a concentrated liquid extract made from the dried leaves and flowers of oregano, a common Mediterranean herb. It is prepared by soaking the plant material in alcohol to extract its active compounds. This tincture is widely used in herbalism for its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and digestive properties. It is often taken internally to support respiratory health, ease digestion, or alleviate menstrual discomfort. Additionally, it can be used externally as a rub to relieve muscle aches and minor skin irritations.
